stories.title: Dow, S&P 500 Edge Higher as Trump Signals Hormuz Deal Nearing; Nasdaq Digests Tech Earnings
stories.summary: The Dow and S&P 500 ticked higher after President Trump said a deal over the Strait of Hormuz was close, easing some geopolitical risk premium in markets. The Nasdaq was more muted as investors worked through a wave of big tech earnings reports.
stories.whyItMatters: Any easing of tension around the Hormuz shipping chokepoint has direct implications for oil flows and energy prices, while the tech earnings digestion will help set the tone for the AI-trade-heavy Nasdaq.
whatToWatch: Further details or confirmation of a Hormuz-related deal
How remaining big tech earnings this week land with investors
questions: What would a Hormuz deal actually entail, and is it finalized or still being negotiated?

stories.title: SpaceX Shares Slide 12% as AI Spending Concerns Overshadow Results
stories.summary: SpaceX shares fell as much as 12% after investors grew rattled by the scale of the company's AI-related spending, according to CNBC and Yahoo Finance. The selloff came even as early returns from that spending were reported, but the market focused on the cost side of the ledger.
stories.whyItMatters: The reaction underscores a broader investor pivot toward scrutinizing whether massive AI capital expenditure is translating into near-term payoff, a question hanging over multiple large-cap names right now.
whatToWatch: Whether SpaceX or company insiders address the spending concerns directly
How other AI-capex-heavy names trade in sympathy
questions: What specifically counted as the 'early returns' investors found insufficient?

stories.title: AMD Drops 8% in Premarket Despite Beating Estimates, as Investors Seek Bigger AI Payoff
stories.summary: AMD shares plunged about 8% in premarket trading even after the company beat earnings expectations, per CNBC and Yahoo Finance. The drop suggests investors wanted stronger signals on AI-driven growth rather than just a beat against estimates.
stories.whyItMatters: It's another sign that for AI-exposed chipmakers, beating Wall Street numbers isn't enough anymore — the market is now pricing in outsized AI payoff expectations that make even solid results a sell trigger.
whatToWatch: AMD's forward guidance and any management commentary on AI demand

questions: What specific guidance or metric fell short of the AI-growth bar investors were expecting?

stories.whyItMatters: A top hedge fund's outsized win on a specific stock theme often signals where sophisticated money is positioning, which can influence flows into similar names.

stories.title: CVS Health Raises Profit Forecast After Beating Estimates on Stronger Insurance, Drug Revenue
stories.summary: CVS Health topped Wall Street estimates and raised its annual profit guidance, with CNBC and Yahoo Finance both pointing to continued improvement in the insurance unit and stronger drug revenues as key drivers.
stories.whyItMatters: CVS's insurance arm has been a persistent pain point for the stock in recent years, so sustained improvement there plus a raised outlook is a meaningful signal the turnaround is gaining traction.
whatToWatch: Updated full-year guidance details and how the insurance unit trends in coming quarters
questions: How much of the beat came from the insurance unit specifically versus pharmacy/drug revenue?

stories.title: Oil Prices Rebound After Houthis Claim Strike on Saudi Tanker
stories.summary: Oil prices moved higher after Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for an attack on a Saudi tanker, according to CNBC and Yahoo Finance. The claim adds a fresh geopolitical risk premium to crude markets.
stories.whyItMatters: Attacks on tankers near key Middle East shipping routes have repeatedly driven volatility in oil prices, which feeds through to energy stocks, inflation expectations, and central bank calculus.
whatToWatch: Confirmation or denial of the strike and any damage/casualty details
Whether shipping insurers or major carriers adjust routes through the region
questions: Has the tanker attack been independently verified beyond the Houthi claim?

stories.title: SoftBank Jumps 13% as Asia Tech Stocks Track Wall Street's AI Rally
stories.summary: SoftBank shares surged 13% as Asian tech stocks broadly rallied, following the lead of an AI-driven rally on Wall Street, per CNBC.
stories.whyItMatters: SoftBank's large AI and tech investment portfolio makes it a bellwether for how global investors are pricing AI-related assets, and a double-digit jump signals strong risk appetite carrying over into Asian trading.

Other Asia tech names' performance in follow-through trading

stories.title: Dow Futures Rise, S&P 500 at Highs as SpaceX and AMD Slide While Arista and Eli Lilly Jump

stories.whyItMatters: The mixed picture — index-level strength alongside sharp individual stock swings — highlights how this earnings season is rewarding and punishing specific companies rather than moving in lockstep with the broader market.
